title: Summit and Horizon
author: Vesper Okafor
blurb: Ada Eriksen, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, has spent ten years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
